fomod.Name: Zenderal - Skip To Taming The Waves
fomod.Author: Zenderal
fomod.Description:
Starts a new Enderal game with the main quest already advanced past "Taming the Waves" (MQ04).
Character creation runs as normal, then the mod picks up where Lishari's taming ritual leaves off: MQ01 "A New Beginning", MQ02 "The Void", MQ03 "The First Steps" and MQ04 "Taming the Waves" are all completed, their rewards handed out by Enderal's own quest scripts, and the Arcane Fever the prologue inflicts is cleared - exactly as finishing MQ04 would.
Because the MQ02 dream is skipped, the mod asks which class you want (Warrior, Mage or Rogue) and hands out that class's starting skillbooks through Enderal's own GivePlayerSkillbook().
DO NOT INSTALL ALONGSIDE Skip Intro SE. Both mods repoint Enderal's game-start marker and place a start trigger; running both will conflict. This mod replaces it.
